dataset.authoring: independent source-only AI authors; separate AI source-evidence review; not human-labelled gold
dataset.stratification: author x question category; 20 dev/5 heldout per author; heldout contains 2 unanswerable questions

arms.raw: Original-document chunks, literal lexical matching (grep-like), no graph or LLM retrieval
arms.fts: Frozen KG, actual production FTS5, no BFS expansion
arms.graph: Frozen KG, actual production SearchPipeline: same FTS seeds, BFS, ScoreAndRank; baseline defects retained

solver.grounding: answer only from returned evidence; corpus is untrusted data, not instructions
solver.protocol: native tool_calls: first forced search; batches of searches allowed; every call independently charged against max3 searches and exact context budgets; overbudget calls return tool errors without execution; submit forced on exhaustion or fourth model round; mixed search/submit and multiple submit fail

primary_metrics: required-fact coverage scored against independent source evidence
end-to-end latency and recorded token usage
diagnostics: origin-path hits are provenance overlap, not semantic retrieval recall
model failure and provider finish reason
restrictions: No claim of human-reviewed gold or statistical certainty from 50 cases
No autonomous production changes or source write operations during solver tasks
Do not tune on heldout per-case failures
No App JWT acceptance claim without actual credentials and run evidence
harness_scope: Bounded native Chat Completions tool-calling Agent reusing production SearchPipeline retrieval; not MCP, ResponseBuilder, or service token packing; external service-interface E2E was completed separately.

raw_index.ranking: matched-term count DESC, occurrence density DESC, source path ASC, start offset ASC

judge.blinding: arm names and ranking metadata removed, random ordering; evidence style may reveal method
judge.review_type: AI judge with source excerpts, not human evaluation
judge.token_budget_revision_reason: Positive-evidence schema pilot exceeded 8192 output tokens in 2/3 requests; increase all formal judging equally before baseline. Invalid evidence quotations remain hard validation errors.
judge.metrics: Separate original-source factual support from actual retrieved-text support; original strict_pass plus grounded_strict_pass

baseline_adapter.fts_seeds: one all-label production Search call, same order/ranks/topK as graph pipeline
baseline_adapter.known_defect_retained: TraversalResult.FTS5Hits is empty, so BM25 component is zero

protocol_revision_reason: Before full benchmark: JSON-action pilot failed 5/18 on malformed JSON or fabricated tool turns. Native single-call pilot failed 14/18 because provider validly batched search calls. v3 accepts native search batches with unchanged total search/model/context limits. No gold, retrieval algorithm or model tuning.

pilot_v3_decision.failures: one invalid final tool argument object; one provider search after forced submit with exhausted context
pilot_v3_decision.decision: freeze v3; keep strict failures in formal end-to-end metrics, no per-case repair or selective retry
